name: Raul Valverde
abstract_title: The integration of the Dual-Function Theory of Neural Computation and the Conscious Electromagnetic Information Field Theory as a framework to unify biofield and neuroscience theories
abstract: Gamma states in the brain have been found to be linked to altered states of consciousness. These results are highly consistent with the EEG studies for Near Death Experiences (NDEs) that document 30- to 90-second bursts of gamma synchrony after cardiac arrest. Previous studies conducted in NDEs with the use of Gas Discharge Visualization technology (GDV), presented sudden increases of bioenergy at the time of death. This shows evidence of a link between Gamma states and the increase of bioenergy
authors: Raul Valverde, Konstantin Korotkov, Chet Swanson, Jennifer Hamilton
field: Information systems, quantum biology, consciousness informatics
notable: Director of Research at Consciousness Research Foundation; author of 'Consciousness, Biofeedback and Neurotechnology'
notes: Interdisciplinary researcher bridging IT, quantum technologies, psychology, and consciousness.
